pages.title: Trading
pages.text: Most recruitable Illagers must be assigned to $(l:raidborn:mechanics/settlement_mode)Settlement Mode$(/l) and linked to their correct workstation before they can trade. Right-click normally to open the trading screen; shift-right-click is used for recruitment.

pages.title: Trade Conditions
pages.text: Illagers do not trade while sleeping or fighting. Some compatible trade-only Illagers can open trades without joining a settlement.

pages.title: Levels
pages.text: Each Illager has its own offers, experience, and trade level. Levels run from 1 to 5. Gaining experience adds higher-level offers without removing earlier ones.

pages.title: Restocking
pages.text: Used offers restock after the Illager completes another workday. Unique rewards may remain limited. Equipping a Giga Emerald reduces emerald prices during the trade.
